title: You’re invited: Ship It, the Product Builders’ Hackathon
summary: Join the Ship It hackathon on Nov 5 at Mixpanel HQ to build apps, use AI tools, and win prizes with product experts.
body_markdown:
📍


🏙️


You’re invited: Ship It, the Product Builders’ Hackathon


📅


⏱️


Thu, Nov 5 · 3:00–7:15 PM Mixpanel HQ, Pier 1


What would you build in 3 hours?


We’re hosting our first SF hackathon with


Replit, ProductX, and Women In Product


. You’ll go from prompt to a live app in Replit, then use Mixpanel to see how people use it: where they convert, where they drop off, and what to fix next.


Why come


-


Hands-on with what’s new:


see Agent Intelligence, which we launched Oct 1, along with the latest Mixpanel AI features


-


Expert help at your table:


ProductX trainers plus Mixpanel and Replit platform experts


-


It’s free:


platform access, tokens, dinner, drinks, and swag are all on us


-


Prizes:


judges pick a winning team, and each winner gets a $200 gift card and a LinkedIn certificate


-


The people:


Jen Taylor, our CEO, opens the night, and you’ll build alongside PMs, analysts, and engineers from across the Bay Area


It’s invite-only with 50 seats, and we review every request.


Request your spot →


[mxpnl.co/48aUMd7](https://mxpnl.co/48aUMd7) Bring a teammate. Want to know something before you register? Ask in the thread.
